name: fam-06-write
prompt: Audit the locking in session.go: Get keeps Lock (it mutates LastSeen and can delete); ensure Len takes RLock; add a comment on each method stating which lock it takes and why. No behavior change; the audit comments plus any lock correction are the deliverable.

go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
